description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Ice)

Benefit: As long as you have an elemental (ice) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can create a 15-foot cone-shaped burst of ice, dealing 1d6 points of ice damage per level of the highest-level ice spell you can cast. A successful Reflex save halves the damage. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (ice) spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Ice)
